name: M'ONDUNIQ Laser-IQ Bio-Cell regenerating mask
shortDescription: Bio-cellulose mask with Fucogel complex to finish the Laser-IQ protocol: hydrates, cools and soothes treated skin. 5 pcs, each with 8 ml of serum.
description:
The M'ONDUNIQ Laser-IQ Bio-Cell Repairing and Regenerating Mask is one of the key regenerating elements of the Laser-IQ professional treatment protocol, developed specifically to restore skin comfort and to intensively hydrate and soothe the skin. The extremely fine-structured bio-cellulose mask fits the facial skin perfectly, so the active ingredients work evenly with maximum contact.

The mask contains Fucogel polysaccharide complex, known for its immediate hydrating and soothing effect. It helps reduce the unpleasant feeling of tightness and supports the restoration of the skin's natural protective layer, while providing long-lasting comfort even for sensitive or stressed skin.

Used as part of the Laser-IQ protocol, it helps the skin regenerate faster after Carbon Peeling and other energy-based treatments, while visibly improving hydration and the overall appearance of the skin.

The first 15–20 minutes after treatment are crucial: during this period the skin is particularly sensitive, loses moisture intensively and is actively working on starting its natural regeneration processes. In this critical phase, the Bio-Cell mask hydrates the freshly treated skin, reduces the feeling of warmth and tightness, moderates temporary redness, supports the restoration of the protective layer and helps preserve the optimal skin environment created after the treatment – while significantly increasing client comfort.

The aim of Carbon Peeling, Q-switched ND:YAG and other energy-based procedures is to stimulate the skin and activate natural renewal, but proper aftercare is essential for this. That is why the Bio-Cell mask is not a simple "finishing mask" but one of the key elements of the overall treatment result: in the Laser-IQ Carbon Peeling system it is a practically indispensable step that helps the skin regain its comfort faster, while the client immediately feels their skin is fresher, more revitalized and more hydrated.

The mask is an excellent choice to finish the following professional treatments: Carbon Peeling, Q-switched ND:YAG treatments, cold plasma treatments, microneedling treatments, nano-infusion, RF microneedling treatments, Hydra treatments and chemical peels – and at the end of any treatment where quickly soothing and hydrating the skin is important.

The M'ONDUNIQ Laser-IQ Bio-Cell repairing and regenerating mask is recommended exclusively for professional cosmetic and aesthetic treatments, especially as part of the Laser-IQ Carbon Peeling protocol. Pack size: 5 bio-cellulose masks, each soaked in 8 ml of serum.

featureRows.headline: Why is the Laser-IQ Bio-Cell Mask essential after laser treatments?
featureRows.subtitle: Professional bio-cellulose mask for regeneration after laser and intensive aesthetic treatments.

features.title: The essential finish of the Laser-IQ protocol
features.description:
During professional laser treatments the skin is exposed to a significant energy load. The aim of Carbon Peeling, Q-switched ND:YAG treatments and other energy-based procedures is to stimulate and renew the skin and activate its natural regeneration processes. However, for this process to take place as optimally as possible, proper aftercare is essential.

The Laser-IQ Bio-Cell Mask is not a simple "finishing mask" but one of the key elements of the overall treatment result. The bio-cellulose carrier adheres extremely closely to the skin, working almost like a second skin. This allows Fucogel and the hydrating components to work with maximum effectiveness, while the mask cools and soothes the treated area.

The first 15–20 minutes after treatment are crucial

During this period the skin is particularly sensitive, loses moisture intensively and is actively working on starting its natural regeneration processes. In this critical phase, the Laser-IQ Bio-Cell Mask:

intensively hydrates the freshly treated skin
reduces the feeling of warmth and tightness
moderates temporary redness
supports the restoration of the skin's natural protective layer
helps preserve the optimal skin environment created after the treatment
significantly increases client comfort

Part of the professional treatment protocol

The highest-standard laser treatments do not end with the last laser pulse. A truly professional protocol always includes a regeneration phase as well.

That is why using the Laser-IQ Bio-Cell Mask is not merely recommended but a practically indispensable step in the Laser-IQ Carbon Peeling system. It helps the skin regain its comfort faster and lets the client immediately feel their skin is fresher and more hydrated, while raising the professional post-treatment experience to a higher level.

The Laser-IQ Bio-Cell Mask is therefore not an optional extra but the essential final step of the complete Laser-IQ protocol.
features.highlight: The best Carbon Peeling results are not created when the laser is switched off – but when the treatment is followed by professional regeneration.
